_comment: PROPOSED waivers for check 3 (regression against the published build), produced by the regression triage of 2026-10-20 (docs/accept/triage/REGRESSION-TRIAGE.md). NOT applied: tools/accept/regression_waivers.json is unchanged. Every entry names the defect ids it covers, the decision or documentation it rests on (evidence), and automated assertions (docs/accept/triage/assert_waivers.mjs) that prove the intentional replacement exists in the candidate and that nothing else changed on that surface; a waiver is valid only while all of them pass (and the waivers it dependsOn). `waivers` (33) cover the 53 defects; `supportingChecks` holds the shared sub-page layer that the screenshot waivers depend on; `predictedForFinalBuild` holds the data waiver for the DATA group, which has no defect in the R1c dry run but will have about 33 in the final one. Fields kind/target/reason/approvedBy/date keep the format of regression_waivers.json. approvedBy is deliberately NOT a person: the integrator records who accepted it. || R1 variant (2026-10-20, Release 1 integration): allowGroups also names the page-group spellings PG-zimg (IMG staged as a page group) and PG-zcopy2 (COPY2 staged as a page group); W-data-manifest also tolerates the removal of the "screenshots" key by IMG (owner decision 2026-10-19 item 2 and IMG-overlay.json: the PWA screenshots were never screenshots).

candidate.note: the CONDITIONAL entry fails on this zip by design; re-run assert_waivers.mjs on the final zip with --anchors <its release/<train>/anchors.json>

The DATA group does both on purpose (about 33 files: unsupported commander fates and position notes removed, contradictory or pre-arrival duplicate position rows removed, the raw `highest_single_regiment_rate` note replaced); each of its 2,364 data patches is listed with class, source and what was before in docs/data-audit/fixes.json. This waiver is valid for a data file only while a patch of a group with a recorded decision accounts for it.

evidence.quote: Every displayed time, place, number and name is either verified against a cited source, labelled as an estimate with its uncertainty, or removed.
About 2,470 small, exact edits. Each one says what it finds ..., what it puts instead, which source it rests on, and what was wrong before ... What nothing supports is taken out.
